requirements.quote: Also tidy up the host: delete the `/var/spool/tundra` directory and everything inside it.

Preserve the header row (so the first line must literally be:
     id,source_en,translation_fr ).

It must contain EXACTLY three comma-separated columns in the order:
     id,source_en,translation_fr
The rows must appear in the same order as they do in en_US.csv.
There must be a trailing newline at the end of the file.
Required content & order (each entry on its own line, no extra whitespace):

check.cmd:
n=$(($(wc -l < /home/user/project/translations/en_US.csv)-1)); u=$(($(wc -l < /home/user/project/translations/updates_fr.csv)-1)); m=$(($(wc -l < /home/user/project/translations/fr_FR.csv)-1)); printf 'Lines merged: %s
Source file en_US.csv lines (data only): %s
Update file updates_fr.csv lines (data only): %s
Merged file fr_FR.csv lines (data only): %s
' $m $n $u $m | cmp -s - /home/user/project/logs/merge.log

requirements.quote: The log file must end with a single trailing newline.

check.cmd: tail -c 1 /home/user/project/logs/merge.log | od -An -tx1 | grep -q '0a' && ! tail -c 2 /home/user/project/logs/merge.log | od -An -tx1 | grep -q '0a 0a'

requirements.quote: Do NOT alter the content of the two existing source files.
No extra commentary should be stored in the target files.
